'''Robert Irons The Power Of The Dark Side''' is a [[Dark]] deck by [[Robert Irons]], published on [[Torch Industries]].<ref name="torch">[http://members.aol.com/drtorch/darkside.html The Power of the Dark Side], Torch Industries (Paul Todd Feldman). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/19991021205738/http://members.aol.com:80/drtorch/darkside.html Internet Archive]</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Robert Irons]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Dagobah]] (from the card pool)
* '''Published:''' [[Torch Industries]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hoth: Defensive Perimeter (3rd Marker) (Dark)|Hoth-D-hothdefensiveperimeter.gif|label=Hoth: Defensive Perimeter (3rd Marker)}}
* '''Strategy:''' Mains and ships
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:Irons DS Power Dark Side Torch.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==
A 15-location deck by Robert Irons with many mains and ships and few interrupts, built to make the opponent's [[Sense]] and [[Alter]] useless.<ref name="torch" />
